## Rove 0.1.9 beta

- One shared Workspace bar across main pages, with repository and branch context. Choose Top (default) or Bottom and Git visibility in Settings → Appearance.
- Portable `.rove-theme.json` Import / Export with Preview / Apply / Discard, including Workspace bar colors. Added bundled interface and editor fonts.
- Workspace and Environment variables now use paired shared YAML and local `.env` files. Separate Variables / Secrets tabs retain the existing table and `{{name}}` references, with explicit Unmask / Mask and guarded local-value saves.
- Custom Environment colors and optional confirmation before Send / Run, including effective fixed Case and called Request environments. Protected CLI runs require matching `--confirm-env`; unattended Schedules reject confirmation-required environments.
- Redesigned variable details cards, exact flexible variable names, clearer Import diagnostics, compact Request chrome and hierarchy guides, and Request Settings refinements.
- Fixed PDF viewer CSS interference, Git/Secret file safety, local Secret replacement baselines and uncertain Environment deletion recovery.
- Updated README and feature documentation, with additional ownership and save/recovery fixes from the source review.

Windows x64 and macOS Apple Silicon packages are provided. This is an optional beta update; minimum supported version remains 0.1.1.

Existing workspaces remain readable. Saving paired variable files uses workspace manifest v10 and requires Rove 0.1.9 or a compatible reader. Flexible Script/Capture syntax uses Request v27 / workflow v8. Keep collaborators on compatible readers. Legacy desktop OS-store values remain available until deliberately saved locally; reads do not export them automatically. Local `.env` files are plaintext and should stay ignored by Git.

Theme files contain colors only. Fonts, Workspace bar placement/Git visibility and other device preferences remain local. macOS beta packages use ad-hoc platform signing without Apple notarization. Installed update/restart and native dialog acceptance remain separate from source, packaging and updater-signature checks.
